tool_signatures.name: itasca_browse_commands
tool_signatures.description: Browse Itasca command documentation by path (like glob + cat).

command.description:
Itasca command to browse (space-separated, matching Itasca command syntax). Examples:
- None or '': List all command categories
- 'ball': List all ball commands
- 'ball create': Get ball create documentation
- 'contact': List all contact commands
- 'contact property': Get contact property command documentation

version.description: Documentation version to browse. Defaults to 7.0 for multi-version engines (PFC: 6.0/7.0/9.0, FLAC: 7.0/9.0, 3DEC: 7.0/9.0); 9.0-only engines (MPoint, MassFlow) always resolve at 9.0.

tool_signatures.name: itasca_browse_python_api
tool_signatures.description: Browse Itasca Python SDK documentation by path (like glob + cat).

api.description:
Itasca Python API path to browse (dot-separated, starting from itasca). Examples:
- None or '': Root overview - all modules and objects
- 'itasca': Core module functions (command, cycle, gravity, etc.)
- 'itasca.ball': Ball module functions (create, find, list, etc.)
- 'itasca.ball.create': Specific function documentation
- 'itasca.ball.Ball': Ball object method groups
- 'itasca.ball.Ball.pos': Specific method documentation
- 'itasca.wall.facet': Nested submodule
- 'itasca.wall.facet.Facet': Facet object in wall.facet module

tool_signatures.name: itasca_browse_reference
tool_signatures.description: Browse ITASCA reference documentation (syntax elements, model properties).

topic.description:
Reference topic to browse (space-separated path). Categories vary by engine — call with no topic first to discover them. Examples (by engine):
- None or '': List all reference categories for the chosen engine
- PFC 'contact-models' / 'contact-models linear': contact model + its properties
- FLAC 'constitutive-models' / 'constitutive-models mohr-coulomb': zone model + properties
- 3DEC 'joint-models' / 'joint-models mohr': joint (sub-contact) model + properties
- 'range-elements' / 'range-elements cylinder': range filter syntax (all engines)
- 'plot-items' / 'plot-items <type>' / 'plot-items <type> <sub>': plot item keywords

version.description: Documentation version (PFC: 6.0/7.0/9.0, FLAC: 7.0/9.0). Only gates version-specific items (e.g. PFC contact models by availability). range-elements, plot-items, and the FLAC/3DEC reference sets are version-agnostic, so the value is ignored for them. 9.0-only engines (MPoint, MassFlow) always resolve at 9.0.
